title: Hulla
description: Raj and his wife expect peace in the their new flat. But thanks to the watchman's whistle Raj becomes sleep-deprived.

title: Dil Bechara
description: A love story involving two cancer patients, starring Sushant Singh Rajput and Sanjana Sanghi. Based on the novel The Fault in Our Stars' by John Green.

title: Dhol
description: Four carefree friends try to marry a rich girl to escape poverty but land in a crime mystery. Hilarity, chaos, and unexpected twists follow in this classic comedy of greed and mischief.

title: Aunty No. 1
description: When Gopi is asked to pretend to his friend Aunt, he doesn't realize the mess he will get into when the real Aunt shows up.

title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham
description: A wealthy couple's adopted son is disowned for marrying a middle-class woman. Years later, his younger brother embarks on a journey to find him, hoping to reunite their broken family.

title: Fear Darr..
description: A man tries to protect an amnesiac from a ghostly spirit.

title: Hiss
description: A man, diagnosed with brain cancer, seeks to obtain 'nagmani' to become immortal. However, deadly challenges await when a mystical cobra shows up.

title: Noorie
description: Yusuf and Noorie are set to get married but after her father's sudden death, the wedding is postponed. While work takes Yusuf out of town, Noorie is left to fend for herself from many evils.

title: What The Fish
description: Sudha hands over the responsibility of her house and pet fish to her niece's fiance before leaving for a holiday. When she returns, all seems fine until she opens the bathroom door.

title: Dhoom 2
description: Mr. A, a daring thief, steals priceless artifacts and partners with a woman he likes but distrusts. Meanwhile, three relentless police officers chase them, leading to a high-stakes pursuit.

title: De De Pyaar De
description: A middle-aged man dating a younger woman faces family drama when he introduces her to his ex-wife and kids. The witty story explores love, maturity, and acceptance across generations.

title: Mohabbatein
description: A stern principal has instituted a strict anti-romance policy. He hires a music teacher who instigates students to follow their heart.
